given: a stock table whose tracking data is held in the combined inventory_code
then: the stock record exposes batch_number and serial_number as distinct, separately addressable fields, while location and the existing inventory_code remain present and unchanged
architectural_notes: Infra: this is a contract on the data-store shape, verified by a parent-aware schema diff of the stock table on the paired Lakebase branch. Realized by an additive Alembic migration (infrastructure) that adds two nullable columns to app/models/stock.py while leaving location and inventory_code untouched; the repository (app/repositories) remains the only layer touching the ORM/session, and the boundary/service are unaffected by this AC. Cross-cutting concern: schema evolution / data durability (R1), owned by the migration, never the domain.
